scenario: Hector worked 18 years as a sandblaster and was diagnosed with silicosis, a disease caused by inhaling silica dust. He files a claim against his most recent employer, FineCoat Inc., where he worked for the last three years. Sandblasting at FineCoat routinely generated silica dust, and Hector worked on the line daily.
